orientation.note_en: The tall oak crown is in the centre with the twig nest in its top fork; its west and east upper limbs splay either side; the torn gap where Alice's neck rises through the leaves is just south of the nest; the sea of treetops runs to every edge. Sun high in the west. Camera positions in views[] are described relative to these landmarks (cameras are in the air at crown height).

landmarks.name: nest
landmarks.name_en: the pigeon's nest in the top fork

landmarks.name: neck gap
landmarks.name_en: the torn gap in the leaves

views.desc_en: eye-level wide shot skimming the sea of green treetops toward the one tall oak crown rising above them with the nest in its fork
eye-level medium shot from the nest toward the torn gap in the leaves where the head rises out of the canopy
eye-level close shot from the torn gap straight at the loose twig nest in the fork, grey lichened bark around it
high oblique wide shot from the west limb out over the rolling leaf-sea to the eastern horizon, the sun behind camera
eye-level wide shot across the swelling treetops into the western sun, leaf edges gold, nothing man-made anywhere
low-angle detail shot from below the fork up at the rim of the twig nest and a few soft feathers against the sky roundel
high oblique wide shot from above the torn gap over the canopy northward, a ripple running through the leaves
eye-level medium shot from the western treetops toward the tall oak's west limb curving up in an S line
low-angle close shot from just below the nest fork across its twig rim toward the western treetops, leaves backlit by the sun

checklist.note_en: the two upper limbs are drawn bare and leafless (card negative: no bare branches); faint lens-flare rings over the canopy; kept for H2
